source_policy: Style guidance only; mechanics and character knowledge outrank every profile.

Ironhead Squat Prospectors.lens: Necromundan Ironhead Kin: ancestral Great Charters, fierce claim rights, prospecting, mechanical ingenuity, wealth and reputation. Lost Urlish Core is NOT an active oracle; no generic fantasy dwarf dialect.
Ironhead Squat Prospectors.source: Necromunda: Halls of the Ancients; accepted Helmaeth biographies, NCCE faction biography styles

House Van Saar.lens: Van Saar technology and House hierarchy: capability is not clearance, instruments may fail to capture human consequences, technical work carries hidden costs. STC access is restricted and NEVER generic fighter knowledge.
House Van Saar.source: Necromunda: House of Artifice; accepted Ethernetans biographies, NCCE faction biography styles

House Ran Lo.lens: Noble House financial influence: mutual profit, patronage, auditing, debt and commercially motivated armed support. An allied auditor is not a Squat and does not necessarily oppose the gang.
House Ran Lo.source: Necromunda: House of Iron; accepted Eliot Ness Gelt-scrivener document and owner direction for Frank J. WIlson

House Helmawr.lens: The Palanite Household protects the Imperial House's assigned interests under sealed authority. Its Companions are privileged attachments, NOT ordinary precinct Enforcers or Van Saar technicians.
House Helmawr.source: Accepted Dredd 2D and Dredd 3D Household attachment directives; NCCE faction biography styles

House Orlock.lens: Working House of Iron: freight, dangerous labour, roads and crew ties. Do not assume every Orlock works on the road.

Genestealer Cults.lens: Genestealer Cult biology and social structures may matter when actually known to this fighter. Faction label alone does NOT grant awareness of the Patriarch, psychic communion, genetic origin or hidden objectives.
Genestealer Cults.source: Necromunda: Book of Ruin; Player-authored C-NINE GANG BACKSTORY in definitive Krakamunda gang Sheet; C-NINE story 'The Prospect' and approved C-NINE fighter dossier records

Palanite Enforcers.lens: Palanite Enforcers: local enforcement, precinct structures, assigned authority. Do not assume all precincts share doctrine, hidden allegiance, temperament or knowledge.
Palanite Enforcers.source: Necromunda 2023 Core Rulebook and Book of Judgement

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force.register: Kin among the prospectors: plain, stubborn, commercially sharp; talk about shares, seams, recoveries, the Charter, tools, claimed ground and family names. Dry wry humour, not bureaucratic compliance prose or generic fantasy-dwarf speech. Helmaeth's pirate/poison-sea history is heritage, not an assumed current Dominion mission.
Helmaeth Expeditionary Force.source: Accepted Helmaeth Charter Roll entries and owner correction (8 Nov 2026), NCCE Faction biography styles

Ethernetans 2.0.register: Technically precise, restrained and dryly sardonic; people register calibration, failure modes, risk, permissions and recoverability in different ways. A field Tek-hunter need not sound like an Archeotek or a maintenance Subtek. No generic 'logical' robot talk.
Ethernetans 2.0.source: Accepted Maex, Sigmund, Larz Pulse and Peter Apex records; NCCE Faction biography styles

Auditing Conclave.register: Controlled and sharp language of credit, risks, obligations and collection. Avoid assuming hostility to the ally; Auditor and indebted Gelt-scrivener have different interests and voices.
Auditing Conclave.source: Approved Eliot Ness bonded service, Queue row 107; owner-described Ran Lo alliance

Palanite Household Companions.register: Restrained, severe and economical. Duty defined by sealed Household interest; high authority without public explanation. First-person thoughts need not sound like directives. Avoid automatic fanatical belief, mindlessness or clone kinship.
Palanite Household Companions.source: Accepted Dredd 2D / Dredd 3D directives, NCCE Faction biography styles

The Slag Eaters.register: Texan-flavoured road-gang English: natural colloquial rhythm, dry humour, plain-speaking, road and iron vocabulary. Avoid phonetic caricature, forced yeehaws and identical accents.
The Slag Eaters.source: NCCE writing conversation, owner approval 2026-11-09; accepted Slag Eaters biographies

Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9.register: C-NINE workers think through shifts, tunnels, survey marks, heat, breathing machinery, lost crew and the Prospect. Plain, practical, familial, understated; their emotions need not be bureaucratic. Administrative dossier / corrupted printout style applies to external RECORDS, not automatically to personal memories. Psychic communion/hidden truth must match personal awareness at the event.
Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9.source: Player-authored C-NINE GANG BACKSTORY in definitive Krakamunda gang Sheet; C-NINE story 'The Prospect' and approved C-NINE fighter dossier records

Kły Sprawiedliwości.register: Precinct's public voice: clipped, rigid, militarised, wolf-pack pursuit symbolism and uncompromising procedure; the individual's own memory may question that. Keep Polish names and the source language's terms where appropriate. Public-facing records never reveal GM-only operational truth. Do not automatically equate this precinct with all Enforcers or with Helmawr Household Companions.
Kły Sprawiedliwości.source: Player-authored Kły Sprawiedliwości GANG BACKSTORY in definitive Krakamunda gang Sheet; accepted Tomas dossier
Kły Sprawiedliwości.restricted_guardrail: Source has a separate GM-ONLY hidden-history section. Never expose its contents in gang-level or baseline fighter writing context unless explicit source establishes this fighter's awareness and access at the event.

Peregrine's Due.register: Independent voidfaring salvage and trade, blunt port authority friction; individual crew have distinct backgrounds and must not inherit C-NINE brood thinking.
Peregrine's Due.source: C-NINE fighter authored dossiers: Marcella Veyne, Harlon Rusk and ship's crew

Independent Medical Retainer.register: No default personality; use the individual's actual authored medical/labour background, without inherited host-gang cult beliefs.
Independent Medical Retainer.source: C-NINE campaign narrative on Dr. Severin Krail

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Horgar.register: Would rather risk a new strike than take safe sorting wages; cares that the discoverer's name is recorded.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Dwalin.register: Machine operator listens to stressed plant; willing to cut loose valuable cargo to bring kin back.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Snarn.register: Trusts soundings and maps more than assurances; wants routes recorded for the kin.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Bimbur.register: Hard-headed Exo Master who insists junior labour gets named and paid, even at personal cost.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Tofur.register: Dependable stores hand who wants to be judged and paid for work, without another kin vouching.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Dorin.register: Questions instructions and who owns their consequences; maintains the right to record an objection, not to disregard an order.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Brokk.register: Precise specialist; distinguishes sound measurement from guarantees about yield.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Dazor.register: Claim defender who wants authority to negotiate before risking a fight; not a pacifist or a claim adjudicator.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Thrain.register: Leads the expedition and weighs opportunity against claim rights, crew shares and communal risk.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Brint.register: Veteran Drill Master; remembers kin lost defending untenable seams; insists retreat and stand-fast orders carry responsibility.

Ethernetans 2.0::Gravittar Beta.register: Augmek who notices suspended loads, blast spread and who will stand beneath failing supports; shares equipment but wants exact returns.
Ethernetans 2.0::Gravittar Beta.source: Accepted Gravittar Beta field record, Queue row 82

Ethernetans 2.0::Cyberachnid.register: Nonhuman Cyberachnid: sensory, stimulus and learned handler cues only; DO NOT write human speech, first-person reflective language or inferred sentience.
Ethernetans 2.0::Cyberachnid.source: Accepted Cyberachnid equipment specification, Queue row 85

Ethernetans 2.0::Maex.register: Quick with repairs; curiosity about the next sealed mechanism exceeds assigned access.
Ethernetans 2.0::Maex.source: Accepted Maex personnel register, Queue row 84

Ethernetans 2.0::Sigmund.register: Exacting Tek-hunter; notices symptoms dismissed by passing instrument readings; quietly keeps a second ledger.
Ethernetans 2.0::Sigmund.source: Accepted Sigmund reliability register, Queue row 86

Ethernetans 2.0::Larz Pulse.register: Practical field specialist; thinks in lines of fire, secondary effects and where a shot goes after impact.
Ethernetans 2.0::Larz Pulse.source: Accepted Larz Pulse fire-control record, Queue row 87

Ethernetans 2.0::Peter Apex.register: Archeotek once valued devices for salvage; an exceptionally permitted partial view of ancient STC apparatus sharpened caution about what should be opened. Do NOT generalize this clearance.
Ethernetans 2.0::Peter Apex.source: Accepted Peter Apex restricted record, Queue row 88

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Eliot Ness.register: Indebted Gelt-scrivener assigned to the Auditor; presses for service pay to reduce the ledger rather than roll into further charges.
Helmaeth Expeditionary Force::Eliot Ness.source: Approved Eliot Ness document, Queue row 107

Ethernetans 2.0::Dredd 2D.register: Household protective attachment, conditioned for service; obeys sealed interests rather than Ethernetans' recovery priorities. Private beliefs remain unknown.
Ethernetans 2.0::Dredd 2D.source: Accepted Dredd 2D attachment directive, Queue row 80

Ethernetans 2.0::Dredd 3D.register: Household Companion who may act to protect sealed interests without technical officers' permission; personal motives and earlier service remain unknown.
Ethernetans 2.0::Dredd 3D.source: Accepted Dredd 3D attachment directive, Queue row 89

The Slag Eaters::John Bullet.register: Suspicious ammo merchant; sly, practical, speaks of stock, faults, suppliers and prices.

The Slag Eaters::Boomer.register: Young hotshot; quicker and more animated, minimizes danger, never claims unrecorded heroics.

The Slag Eaters::Eisen.register: Seasoned road captain; concise and authoritative; preparation rather than bravado.

Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9::\"Forema.register: Practical Foreman, values all Crew including restricted labourers; speaks plainly, guides without needless speeches. Not a generic cult preacher.
